description: Source code for Mattermost slash command providers 'remove' and 'kick', including command registration, trigger retrieval, command creation, and execution logic for removing users from channels.

classes.name: RemoveProvider
classes.description: Provides 'remove' command trigger and execution logic for removing users from channels.

classes.name: KickProvider
classes.description: Provides 'kick' command trigger and execution logic for kicking users from channels.

methods.name: GetTrigger
methods.description: Returns the command trigger string ('remove' or 'kick').

methods.name: GetCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns the command object with trigger, description, hint, and display name.

methods.name: DoCommand
methods.description: Executes the command to remove or kick a user from a channel, handling permission checks and errors.
